author: Chris12M9
body:
Hello, my name is Chris12M9.
I have been temp banned for spawn killing.
I think i should be unbanned because, i honestly, honestly did not think i could be banned for that. I was on the nebula playing on quintus and i was spawn killing the opposition, well that's what seemed to look like. I do honestly with the most respect say, spawn killing was not my intention, i was only being killed many times trying to get to the obsidian but many of the players came to stop me, so i tried to hold them back. This looked like i was spawn killing. I am deeply sorry for this and i promise this will never happen again.
I assure you spawn killing was not my intention and i have always lived up to the rules set by Avic.us. I do think they are fair and i am sorry for this. It will not ever happen again.
